The '''Yout system''' was located in the [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]] and the [[Vvan system]] of the [[Tyan sector/Legends|Tyan sector]]<ref name="EGTW" /> and contained the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yout 12]], also known as the twelfth moon of Yout.<ref name="CSWE" />

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|droid]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[KRONOS-327/Legends|KRONOS-327]] carried out an unsuccessful [[Mission to Yout 12|elimination attempt]] on a [[Vigo]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization on Yout 12 on behalf of the Vigo's rival, the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="TCW VG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Yout [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> while between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] it lay within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yout system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
